sloka: तच्छैलशृङ्गं बहुवृक्षसानुं प्रगृह्य चिक्षेप निशाचराय ।तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य बिभेद बाणैस्तपनीयपुङ्खैः ।। ६.५९.३७ ।।।।
transliteration: tacchailaśṛṅgaṁ bahuvṛkṣasānuṁ pragṛhya cikṣepa niśācarāya ।tamāpatantaṁ sahasā samīkṣya bibheda bāṇaistapanīyapuṅkhaiḥ ।। 6.59.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Seizing mountain tops whose slopes were filled with trees Sugriva hurled at the night rangers. Watching this Ravana quickly broke them with his arrows fixed with golden shafts.
